verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bird & Bird advising incubators and accelerators as clients, plus a TwoVenture guidance hub for start-ups. Neither is a documented program or partnership with accelerators, incubators or university ecosystems that gives early startups structured access to the firm. These items are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents programs or partnerships with accelerators, incubators, or university ecosystems that give early startups structured access
